title: Work, Energy, Power & Collisions
syllabus: Work done by a constant force and a variable force, Kinetic and potential energies, Work-energy theorem, Power, Potential energy of a spring, Conservation of mechanical energy, Conservative and non-conservative forces, Motion in a vertical circle, Elastic and inelastic collisions in one and two dimensions

title: Thermodynamics
syllabus: Thermal equilibrium, Zeroth law of thermodynamics, Concept of temperature, Heat, Work and internal energy, First law of thermodynamics, Isothermal and adiabatic processes, Isobaric and isochoric processes, Cyclic and non-cyclic processes, Second law of thermodynamics, Reversible and irreversible processes, Heat engines and refrigerators

title: Thermal Properties of Matter
syllabus: Heat, Temperature, Thermal expansion, Specific heat capacity, Calorimetry, Change of state, Latent heat, Heat transfer - Conduction, Convection, Radiation, Newton's law of cooling, Stefan-Boltzmann law, Wien's displacement law

title: Rotational Motion - 2
syllabus: Moment of inertia, Radius of gyration, Values of moments of inertia for simple geometrical objects, Parallel and perpendicular axes theorems and their applications, Equilibrium of rigid bodies, Rigid body rotation and equations of rotational motion, Comparison of linear and rotational motions

title: Rotational Motion - 1
syllabus: Centre of mass of a two-particle system, Centre of mass of a rigid body, Basic concepts of rotational motion, Moment of a force, Torque, Angular momentum, Conservation of angular momentum and its applications

title: Properties of Solids
syllabus: Elastic behaviour, Stress-strain relationship, Hooke's Law, Young's modulus, Bulk modulus, Modulus of rigidity, Elastic potential energy, Poisson's ratio

title: Properties of Fluids
syllabus: Pressure due to a fluid column, Pascal's law and its applications, Effect of gravity on fluid pressure, Viscosity, Stokes' law, Terminal velocity, Streamline and turbulent flow, Critical velocity, Bernoulli's principle and its applications, Surface energy and surface tension, Angle of contact, Excess pressure across a curved surface, Applications of surface tension - drops, bubbles, and capillary rise

title: Oscillations
syllabus: Periodic and oscillatory motions, Period, Frequency, Displacement as a function of time, Periodic functions, Simple Harmonic Motion (SHM) and its equation, Phase, Velocity and acceleration in SHM, Force law for SHM, Energy in SHM (Kinetic and Potential energies), Simple pendulum and derivation of its time period, Oscillations of a spring (mass-spring system, series and parallel combinations), Free, forced and damped oscillations, Resonance

title: Kinetic Theory of Gases
syllabus: Equation of state of a perfect gas, Work done on compressing a gas, Kinetic theory of gases - assumptions, Concept of pressure, Kinetic interpretation of temperature, RMS, average and most probable speeds of gas molecules, Degrees of freedom, Law of equipartition of energy and applications to specific heat capacities of gases (monoatomic, diatomic, polyatomic gases and mixtures), Mean free path, Avogadro's number

title: Gravitation
syllabus: Universal law of gravitation, Acceleration due to gravity and its variation with altitude and depth, Kepler's laws of planetary motion, Gravitational potential energy, Gravitational potential, Escape velocity, Motion of a satellite, Orbital velocity, Time period and energy of a satellite

title: Units and Measurements
syllabus: Units of measurements, System of Units, SI Units, Fundamental and Derived units, Least count, Significant figures, Errors in measurements, Dimensions of Physical quantities, Dimensional analysis and its applications

title: Sequence and Series
syllabus: Arithmetic Progression (AP), Geometric Progression (GP), Harmonic Progression (HP), Arithmetic-Geometric Series (AGP), AM-GM-HM Inequalities, Telescopic Series & Special Sequences

title: NEET Practice Test: Kinematics, Current Electricity & Heating Effects
syllabus: Kinematics (Motion in a Straight Line, Motion in a Plane, Relative Motion, Graphs), Current Electricity (Ohm's Law, Drift Velocity, Cells & Circuits, Kirchoff's Laws, Measuring Instruments), Heating Effects of Current

title: Motion in a Straight Line (Kinematics Part 1)
syllabus: Frame of reference, Motion in a straight line, Position-time graph, Speed and velocity, Uniform and non-uniform motion, Average speed and instantaneous velocity, Uniformly accelerated motion, Velocity-time graph, Position-time graph, Relations for uniformly accelerated motion

title: Motion in a Plane and Vectors
syllabus: Scalars and Vectors, Vector addition and subtraction, Scalar and vector products, Unit vector, Resolution of a vector, Relative velocity, Motion in a plane, Projectile motion, Uniform circular motion

title: Laws of Motion Part 2: Friction & Circular Dynamics
syllabus: Static and Kinetic friction, Laws of friction, Rolling friction, Dynamics of uniform circular motion, Centripetal force and its applications, Vehicle on a level circular road, Vehicle on a banked road

title: Laws of Motion Part 1
syllabus: Force and inertia, Newton's First law of motion, Momentum, Newton's Second Law of motion, Impulses, Newton's Third Law of motion, Law of conservation of linear momentum and its applications, Equilibrium of concurrent forces

title: Inverse Trigonometric Functions & SOT
syllabus: Inverse Trigonometric Functions (Properties, Principal Values, Equations & Inequalities), Solution of Triangles

title: Rotational Motion, Gravitation and Mechanical Properties of Solids
